function prefix<T extends string>(value: `prefix-${T}` | number): T {
  return String(value).slice('prefix-'.length) as T;
}
function whole<T extends string>(value: `${T}` | number): T {
  return String(value) as T;
}
const prefixed = prefix('prefix-hello');
const unprefixed = whole('world');
const hello: 'hello' = prefixed;
const world: 'world' = unprefixed;
console.log(hello, world);

function leaf<T>(value: { a: { b: { c: { d: T } } } } | undefined): T {
  if (value === undefined) throw Error();
  return value.a.b.c.d;
}
function entry<T>(value: { a: { b: { c: T[] } } } | undefined): T {
  if (value === undefined) throw Error();
  return value.a.b.c[0];
}
const number = leaf({ a: { b: { c: { d: 1 } } } });
const text = entry({ a: { b: { c: ['word'] } } });
console.log(number.toFixed(), text.toUpperCase());

class Getter {
  get value() {
    do { return 7; } while (false);
  }
}
console.log(new Getter().value);

const numericKeys: Record<number, string> = { 1: 'one' };
const knownKey: Record<1, string> = numericKeys;
console.log(knownKey[1]);
